items.html: And afterward, when Adam HaRishon came and corrected his deeds — and through the correction of his deeds he fenced the vineyard and cut off the thorns that were attached there, and cut down all the Klipot from there — he returned them face to face. However, Adam HaRishon was able to correct only the upper worlds, but the world of Assiya, which is entirely Klipot, he did not correct, and this world remained in the aspect of back to back.
